summary: perf(shared): replace pruneSessionTokens Lua script with a WATCH transaction
description:
Because:

* The pruneSessionTokens_1 Lua script runs the prune inside Redis.

This commit:

* Replaces the script with a WATCH, MULTI and EXEC prune in TypeScript
* Runs prunes one at a time on a duplicate Redis connection
* Retries a conflicted prune up to three times, then rejects
* Disconnects the prune connection in close() when its quit fails

Closes FXA-14945
